openFindings.actualFinding: The main data/control, fairness and accountability lenses are useful and outcomes remain questions. The fictional friendly AI is a conceptual character, not a claim that systems are sentient or automatically neutral. No private data are shown. The background health building carries a recognizable red cross on a white sign, reproducing the distinctive protected/identification emblem rather than a neutral generic health symbol.
